question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

His ___________ of the new policy was based on a careful analysis of its long-term implications.
solution:
The correct answer is '**assessment**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**assessment**" means the process of evaluating or analyzing something. (मूल्यांकन)
 
• The context of the sentence indicates that the person carefully analyzed the long-term implications of the policy, and the word "assessment" fits appropriately.
 
• The other options: "**timidity**," "**courtesy**," and "**shyness**" do not align with the context of evaluation or analysis.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *His assessment__ of the new policy was based on a careful analysis of its long-term implications.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Timidity (भीरुता)**: means lack of courage or confidence.
 
• **Courtesy (शिष्टाचार)**: means politeness in behavior or speech.
 
• **Shyness (संकोच)**: means the quality of being reserved or nervous in social situations.
